QuestInfo.name: [Knight Stronghold] The End is Around the Corner
QuestInfo.0: You'll need the Dream Key to open the garden gate and reach the corrupted Empress. #bJay#k in #bHenesys Ruins#k seems to have the key. Go talk to Jay.
QuestInfo.1: Jay made the Dream Key with the intent of someday using it to fight Cygnus. Jay said he will open the garden gate. Talk with #bChief Alex#k before going.
QuestInfo.2: You told Chief Alex what you discussed with Jay.

yes.0: I know I'm quite weak compared to you but when the time is right, I will be of help. So don't worry about me. I've been training with Anne all this time.
yes.1: I will open the gate to the Cygnus Garden for you, but please meet with #bAlex#k before we go. I'll contact Anne in the meantime. She'll want to participate in this battle as much as I do.

0.0: In the past, there were adventurers who formed a party to defeat the corrupted Empress. They were the ones who also made the #bDream Key#k.
0.1: To get to the Empress and save Maple World, they headed into the garden. However, #rthey never returned#k... I somehow managed to collect their belongings. There, I found the method to make the Dream Key.
0.2: So I made the Dream Key with the intent to someday travel through the garden and fight Cygnus myself. And I think the time has finally come.

no.0: Please let me come with you. I beg of you. All my warlock training has been for this moment.

1.0: Did you learn about the key to Cygnus Garden?

yes.0: Jay had the key? That's amazing. Huh, suddenly we're so close to the end...

npc.0: Please meet with Alex first before we go. I'll contact Anne in the meantime. She'll want to participate in this battle as much as I do.
